capture_method: Verbatim transcription of the newest edition listed on the official index at read time (the index ends at 01:30 PM ET for 2026-11-14). Supersedes the 04:15 AM ET edition the site currently prices from (S10). Rows are limited to the 11/14 games; the 11/15 games are all printed NOT YET SUBMITTED and 11/16-11/17 have no rows at all.
binary_pdf_note: The binary PDF is NOT archived in this sandbox: the shell egress allowlist has no route to ak-static.cms.nba.com, and the only available route to it is the text-extraction fetch channel, which returns extracted text rather than bytes. What is stored is the verbatim row transcription, the SHA-256 of the transcribed row text, the official PDF URL on every row, the edition revision stamp and the retrieval time. This archive is therefore a text archive and is not represented as a binary one.
